name: Self-Directed Queries Complexity / Minimum Teaching Set Size
details: For every finite concept class, $\mathrm{SDC}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: This is Lemma 7 of Doliwa--Fan--Simon--Zilles, attributed there to Kuhlmann: every finite concept class satisfies $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{SDC}(\mathcal H)$.  It is a direct comparison of the two models, not a transitive graph inference.
